text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“—My heart is squeezing and racing, so, so 
much~... Fufu, ehehehe.”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(I still remember Air Groove-san singing 
this song, and Mejiro Ramonu-san too. 
Vividly... They were so, so dazzling!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
All right, someday I'll be in the center 
too! Following my senpais' example, right 
into everyone's hearts—
